title: Short side defense
line: King to the short side of the pawn, rook checking from the long side.

steps.text: The pawn splits the board in two. The side with fewer files, toward h8, is the short side. The other is the long side.
Your king belongs on the short side. Your rook belongs on the long side, far from the pawn, where its checks have room.
The white rook threatens your back row. Step your king to the short side.

also.a2e2: That holds for now, from behind. This lesson moves the king to the short side.
also.a2a6: That check holds for now. This lesson moves the king to the short side.

wrong.e8d8: That walks into mate: the white rook checks on your back row.

steps.hint: Toward the ringed square on the short side.
steps.after: Your king is on the short side, and your rook has the whole long side.

steps.text: The white king has stepped up. Check it from the side, from as far away as you can.

also.a1d1: That check from behind holds too. This lesson checks from the side.

wrong.f8g8: That loses: here the rook must check at once, before the white king and pawn step up.
wrong.a1e1: That loses: here the rook must check at once, before the white king and pawn step up.
wrong.a1f1: That loses: here the rook must check at once, before the white king and pawn step up.
wrong.a1g1: That loses: here the rook must check at once, before the white king and pawn step up.

steps.after: From far away the rook checks again and again, and the white king finds no shelter.

summary: Defending a rook ending, keep your king on the short side of the pawn and your rook far away on the long side.
